basic_profile.bio: Based in Gaithersburg, I'm a devoted fan of Playboi Carti and love discussing his music and lifestyle. I'm a night owl, often active on Reddit during late evenings when I'm not working my retail job. I enjoy gaming, especially World of Tanks Console, and have a casual interest in reality TV shows like Love Island Australia. I'm currently single and spend my weekends exploring local music scenes or attending hip-hop events.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a deep interest in hip-hop music, particularly Playboi Carti. My knowledge is mostly self-taught, stemming from countless hours of listening to music and engaging with online fan communities. Additionally, I have a basic understanding of video game mechanics from years of playing World of Tanks Console.
